name: James Talarico
summary:
James Dell Talarico ( TAL-ə-REE-koh, born May 17, 1989) is an American politician and educator who is a United States senator-elect from Texas. A member of the Democratic Party, he has served since 2018 as a member of the Texas House of Representatives.
Born in Round Rock, Texas, Talarico taught sixth-grade language arts at Rhodes Middle School in West San Antonio, Texas, from 2011 to 2013.
